name: zum Peerli
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Tirol – where the Peerli awaits! Discover the heart of the Tirol with its breathtaking alpine landscapes, charming villages, and world-class outdoor adventures.
beschreibung:
The entry zum Peerli is listed in the Tyrol Tourism portal under the gastronomy category and is classified as a café. It describes a cosy establishment in the Zillertal that invites guests to take a break, serving freshly brewed coffee along with delicious cakes and snacks. According to the text available, the team pampers its guests with a lovingly curated selection, with quality and enjoyment at the heart of it all.

A clear confirmation from an official source – such as the establishment's own website, the local municipality, a tourism association or an official register – was not possible. For this reason, the address, telephone number, email address and website are deliberately not provided here. The Zillertal, a broad side valley of the Inn Valley, is known for its traditional Tyrolean gastronomy, ranging from coffee houses to mountain huts. Coffee lovers and connoisseurs will find plenty of places to stop for a bite or a drink.
